name: Sikadur®-330
tagline: 2-component epoxy impregnation resin for SikaWrap CFRP systems and Near Surface Mounted CFRP
summary: Sikadur®-330 is a 2-component, thixotropic epoxy based impregnating resin and adhesive.
metaDescription: Sikadur®-330 is a 2-component, thixotropic epoxy based impregnating resin and adhesive.
attributes: Easy mix and application by trowel and impregnation roller
Excellent application behaviour to vertical and overhead surfaces
usage: Impregnation resin for SikaWrap® fabric reinforcement for the dry application method
Primer resin for the wet application system
Structural adhesive for bonding Sika® CarboDur® plates into slits
advantages: Easy mix and application by trowel and impregnation roller
Excellent application behaviour to vertical and overhead surfaces

items.label: Composition
items.text: Epoxy resin

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: 24 months from date of production

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Store in original, unopened, sealed and undamaged packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +30 °C. Protect from direct sunlight.

items.label: Density
items.text: 1.30 ± 0.1 kg/l (component A+B mixed) (at +23 °C)

items.label: Viscosity
items.text:
Shear rate: 50 /s
Temperature | Viscosity
+10 °C | ~10 000 mPas
+23 °C | ~ 6 000 mPas
+35 °C | ~ 5 000 mPas

items.label: System structure
items.text: Substrate primer - Sikadur®-330. Impregnating / laminating resin - Sikadur®-330. Structural strengthening fabric - SikaWrap® type to suit requirements.

items.label: Mixing ratio
items.text: Component A : component B = 4 : 1 by weight When using bulk material the exact mixing ratio must be safeguarded by accurately weighing and dosing each component.

items.label: Ambient air temperature
items.text: +10 °C min. / +35 °C max.

items.label: Dew point
items.text: Beware of condensation. Substrate temperature during application must be at least 3 °C above dew point.

items.label: Substrate temperature
items.text: +10 °C min. / +35 °C max.

items.label: Substrate moisture content
items.text: < 4 % pbw

items.label: Pot Life
items.text:
Temperature | Pot life | Open time
+10 °C | ~90 minutes (5 kg) | ~90 minutes
+23 °C | ~60 minutes (5 kg) | ~60 minutes
+35 °C | ~30 minutes (5 kg) | ~30 minutes
The pot life begins when the resin and hardener are mixed. It is shorter at high temperatures and longer at low temperatures. The greater the quantity mixed, the shorter the pot life. To obtain longer workability at high temperatures, the mixed adhesive may be divided into portions. Another method is to chill components A+B before mixing them (not below +5 °C).

items.label: Consumption
items.text: See the "Method Statement for SikaWrap® manual dry application" Ref 850 41 02. Guide: 0.7 - 1.5 kg/m2

items.label: SUBSTRATE QUALITY
items.text: Substrate must be sound and of sufficient tensile strength to provide a minimum pull off strength of 1.0 N/mm2 or as per the requirements of the design specification. See also the "Method Statement for SikaWrap® manual dry application" Ref 850 41 02.

items.label: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text: See the "Method Statement for SikaWrap® manual dry application" Ref 850 41 02.

items.label: MIXING
items.text:
Pre-batched units: Mix components A+B together for at least 3 minutes with a mixing spindle attached to a slow speed electric drill (max. 300 rpm) until the material becomes smooth in consistency and a uniform grey colour. Avoid aeration while mixing. Then, pour the whole mix into a clean container and stir again for approx. 1 more minute at low speed to keep air entrapment at a minimum. Mix only that quantity which can be used within its pot life.
Bulk packing, not pre-batched: First, stir each component thoroughly. Add the components in the correct proportions into a suitable mixing pail and stir correctly using an electric low speed mixer as above for pre-batched units.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Clean all equipment immediately with Sika® Colma Cleaner. Cured material can only be removed mechanically.
